🖨️ **Printer & Hardware Setup Guide:**

1. Open **Settings** ➔ click the **Printer Configuration** tab.

How do automated backups and CSV spreadsheets work?

💾 **Safe Storage & Automatic Backup:**

• **Non-OS Drive Protection:** Backups are placed on safe non-OS drives (e.g. `D:\LabBackups`) so your data is protected against Windows crashes.
• **Auto-Retention:** The software strictly keeps the **last 5 backups** in both complete JSON and Excel CSV spreadsheet formats, automatically purging older files.
• **Manual Backup:** Go to **Backup & Restore** ➔ click **Sync & Back Up Now** or **Export Patient Directory (CSV)** anytime.
